title: Repository reconciliation detached resolution builder readiness

phases.objective: Provide a lease-bound internal Git-object builder that can create an exact detached reconciliation resolution commit without moving any repository ref or exposing Admin apply.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact expected base/head SHAs, active reconciliation lease evidence, explicit detached-resolution confirmation, and a bounded exact changed-file blob map
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A one-parent detached commit is created from the exact base tree, validates against the work-branch changed-file set, and same-cycle readback proves both base and work-branch refs are unchanged.
steps: Validate the active repository reconciliation lease before resolving any provider token.
Validate the governed work-branch target and exact typed detached-resolution confirmation.
Reject force/ref-update flags and reject unsafe, duplicate, non-blob, unsupported-mode, oversized, missing, or extra resolution entries.
Read same-cycle reconciliation evidence and reject stale expected base/head SHAs or non-diverged branch state.
Read the exact base commit tree and create a Git tree from the exact changed-file blob map.
Create a detached Git commit whose sole parent is the exact expected base SHA.
Read back the detached commit, compare it to the exact base, and reuse governed merge-resolution validation for exact file scope and ancestry.
Re-read reconciliation evidence and prove the base ref and work-branch ref are unchanged without calling any ref mutation endpoint.
assertions: Repository reconciliation lease verification precedes provider access.
Only governed non-protected work branches are eligible.
Resolution entries exactly match the current branch changed-file set and contain at most 50 regular/executable blobs.
The created tree is based on the exact expected base tree.
The detached commit has exactly one parent equal to the expected base SHA.
Existing merge-resolution evidence validation accepts the detached commit before it can feed a later merge-commit step.
No PATCH/DELETE ref mutation or POST /git/refs operation is part of detached construction.
Same-cycle readback proves expected base and work-branch refs remain unchanged.
force_push_allowed remains false, the recipe remains planned, and no Admin apply/tool surface is exposed by this readiness slice.

phases.objective: Bind the detached builder into the separately governed reconciliation executor only after tool-schema lease parity, canonical authority wiring, plan-bound output propagation, and positive same-cycle smoke are complete.
